EmailTemplate.description: Sent to the customer while a UAEDDS direct debit mandate sits in Pending Customer Signature - once by UAEDDS_Pending_Signature_Email when the status is first set, then every 2 days by UAEDDS_Pending_Signature_Reminder until day 7. Merges from DirectDebitRequest__c via the sending action's Related Record ID, so it needs no recipient record and can be sent to a bare address. Deliberately carries no IBAN or account number: this is an unauthenticated channel and the customer already holds those details.
EmailTemplate.name: Pending Customer Signature
EmailTemplate.subject: Action required: your Direct Debit authorisation is awaiting your signature ({!DirectDebitRequest__c.Name})
